text: 会议研究促进招商引资高质量发展有关工作。会议指出，规范招商引资是建设全国统一大市场的重要内容，要持续用力、久久为功，明确政府招商引资鼓励和禁止的具体行为，在总结实践经验的基础上抓细抓好各项工作。要进一步规范地方政府经济促进行为，强化正向引导和刚性约束，把招商引资工作重点更多放在优化营商环境、培育产业生态、提供高水平政务服务上来。要完善与企业沟通交流机制，主动帮助企业解决现实困难问题，为企业发展创造更加公平、更有活力的市场条件。（央视）
text_en: The meeting studied work related to promoting high-quality development of investment attraction. The meeting noted that regulating investment attraction is an important part of building a unified national market, and continued efforts are needed with lasting results, clarifying specific behaviors encouraged and prohibited in government investment attraction, and grasping all work finely on the basis of summarizing practical experience. Further efforts should be made to regulate local government economic promotion behaviors, strengthen positive guidance and rigid constraints, and shift the focus of investment attraction work more to optimizing the business environment, cultivating industrial ecosystems, and providing high-level government services. Mechanisms for communication with enterprises should be improved, actively helping enterprises solve practical difficulties, and creating fairer and more vibrant market conditions for enterprise development. (CCTV)
